verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Mollie has API reference pages under /reference/, such as the Payments, Subscriptions and Balances APIs. It also offers an llms.txt index and markdown mirrors of its docs. Nothing shows these pages are interactive, with in-browser 'try it' consoles or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so the core of the story is unevidenced.
